mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_agent_action ( agent_task_id, step_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, action_name, action_description, payload_json, risk_level, need_confirm, status, requested_time, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, rejected_time, executed_time, result_summary, error_message, version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{agentTaskId}, #{stepId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{actionName}, #{actionDescription}, #{payloadJson}, #{riskLevel}, #{needConfirm}, #{status}, #{requestedTime}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedTime}, #{rejectedTime}, #{executedTime}, #{resultSummary}, #{errorMessage}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_task_id, step_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, action_name, action_description, payload_json, risk_level, need_confirm, status, requested_time, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, rejected_time, executed_time, result_summary, error_message, version, create_time, update_time FROM assistant_agent_action WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, agent_task_id, step_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, action_name, action_description, payload_json, risk_level, need_confirm, status, requested_time, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, rejected_time, executed_time, result_summary, error_message, version, create_time, update_time FROM assistant_agent_action WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} ORDER BY requested_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_agent_action SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, update_time = #{confirmedTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE assistant_agent_action SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_summary = #{resultSummary}, executed_time = #{executedTime}, update_time = #{executedTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXECUTING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE assistant_agent_action SET status = 'REJECTED', result_summary = #{resultSummary}, rejected_time = #{rejectedTime}, update_time = #{rejectedTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
